description: This file defines a database migration class for version 4.0 of the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods to create an 'ohrm_employee_event' table, insert menu items related to OAuth client registration, and retrieve relevant menu IDs. The class extends an abstract migration class and contains logic specific to database schema updates in the migration process.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A migration class responsible for updating the database schema to version 4.0, including creating tables and inserting menu items.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs schema updates: creates the 'ohrm_employee_event' table if it does not exist, and inserts menu items for OAuth client registration.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of this migration, which is '4.0'.
